input: Find arts, crafts, music, theater and dance summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Weaverville, Woodfin, Leicester, Candler, Barnardsville, Marshall, Mars Hill and Hot Springs, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Weaverville Woodfin summer camp art dance music 2026 2025

candidates.name: The Asheville Ballet
candidates.note: Blue Ridge Dance Camp offers intensive ballet and contemporary training for ages 11–18; a 2027 camp is announced, with dates pending.

candidates.name: Celia's Dance Academy
candidates.note: Summer dance camps were advertised for June 2026; contact the studio for session ages and hours.

candidates.name: Mars Hill University
candidates.note: Youth summer music camp for grades 7–12 in 2026; 2025 art camps included drawing, painting, pottery, printmaking and photography.

candidates.name: Southern Appalachian Repertory Theatre
candidates.note: Three-week 2026 youth theatre camp for ages 8–18 at Owen Theatre, culminating in Seussical Jr. performances.

candidates.name: Madison County Arts Council
candidates.note: First Stage Youth Theatre camp for ages 8+ ran in 2025; half-day art camps ran in 2026, and the council also offers JAM summer camp.

candidates.name: Asheville Art Museum
candidates.note: Weekly 2026 art camps for rising K–12 students, with morning and afternoon sessions and a combined full-day option.

candidates.name: Asheville Music School
candidates.note: 2026 camps for ages 4–18 include rock, strings, ukulele, jazz, voice, Appalachian music and audio production.

candidates.name: Music Academy Asheville
candidates.note: Rock Academy summer music camps use the Patton Avenue rehearsal space and finish with a Friday performance for families.

candidates.name: Asheville Community Theatre
candidates.note: Tanglewood Summer provides youth theatre camp; listed in the 2026 local summer camp guide.

candidates.name: Asheville Performing Arts Academy
candidates.note: Nine week-long musical-theatre camps ran June–August 2026, divided into grades 1–3 and 4–9.

candidates.name: Wortham Center for the Performing Arts
candidates.note: 2026 Creative Arts Camps for rising grades 1–5 combine theatre, music and visual arts in partnership with ArtSpace Charter School.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 municipal summer camps include creative activities; the department says 2027 schedules will be published February 1, 2027.
